sources.title: Causality != Invariance: Function and Concept Vectors in LLMs
sources.read_scope: Sections2.1.3-2.1.5,3.1 and selected paragraphs of AppendicesM/O,plus abstract. Not a full-paper or appendix replication.
sources.summary: Causal head selection and format-invariant representation selection can differ. The method forms averaged head-output vectors and sweeps strength and head count;those procedures are not adopted. AppendixM controls output word versus letter format,and AppendixO studies cross-format patching. An output change alone therefore does not identify an invariant concept.
sources.implication: Test semantic versus token-format alternatives explicitly. Do not extract averaged vectors,fit an alignment or select a winning gain.

sources.title: Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and bibliography recheck only.
sources.summary: A successful patch may exploit a pathway different from the feature use one hopes to identify.
sources.implication: Retain clean necessity,rescue,specificity and native-path controls;do not infer original feature use from donor sufficiency.

sources.title: Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and bibliography in this review. Earlier bounded definitions review remains separate.
sources.summary: The framework formalizes faithful high-level descriptions and intervention relations.
sources.implication: A small transfer count is not by itself a formal causal abstraction.

design_consequence: Keep the current N26 protocol fixed. For a later rule-versus-spelling assay,distinguish a state at an actual operator decision from an earlier instruction anchor. Full-site current-state swaps also transplant output-format information;an earlier anchor cannot see later operand order. These are different interventions,not interchangeable proofs of semantic encoding.
conditional_next_branch: A N26 utility signal requires fresh complete-contract confirmation. If both primary screens fail,close this fixed global sparse group and prioritize a prospective task-adequacy and contextual-binding control before another rank or construction sweep. This review fixes no new dataset,threshold,layer universe or GPU launch.
